title: Proper flat right adjoints preserve support over complements of quasi-compact opens
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let f:X\to Y be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and let a be the right adjoint to Rf_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every quasi-compact open V\subset Y with inverse image U\subset X and every Q in D_QCoh(Y) supported on the closed subset Y\setminus V, the object a(Q) is supported on the closed subset X\setminus U.

proof.text: Put T=Y\setminus V and U=f^{-1}(V); U is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. If a(Q) is not supported on X\setminus U, then a(Q)|_U\neq 0, and perfect generation of D_QCoh(\mathcal O_U) [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-perfect-generation] supplies a perfect complex P_U on U and a nonzero map \alpha:P_U\to a(Q)|_U (the objects K with \mathrm{Hom}(P',K[n])=0 for all perfect P' and all n form a subcategory closed under shifts, cones, retracts and direct sums). The perfect-map lifting lemma [lem-sc-perfect-support-map-lift], applied with the closed subset X (empty complement), gives a perfect P on X and a map \beta:P\to a(Q) with P_U a direct summand of P|_U compatibly with \alpha and \beta|_U; hence \beta|_U\neq 0.
By the adjunction Rf_* \dashv a, the lifted map is adjoint to a morphism Rf_*P\to Q.

Since f is proper, flat, and of finite presentation and P is perfect, the perfect-direct-image lemma [lem-pc-proper-support-perfect-direct-image], applied with \mathcal G^\bullet=\mathcal O_X[0] (finitely presented, flat over Y, with support X proper over Y), shows that Rf_*P=Rf_*(P\otimes^L\mathcal O_X) is perfect. Since Q is supported on T and Y\setminus T=V is quasi-compact, case (i) of the support-annihilation lemma [lem-sc-pseudo-coherent-support-annihilation] gives a perfect I and a map I\to\mathcal O_Y that is an isomorphism on V and for which I\otimes^L Rf_*P\to Rf_*P\to Q is zero.

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.4) via Lemmas when-sheafy and proper-flat; perfect.tex Tags 0A1H and 0A9C(1)

proof.text: The derived projection/base-change formula identifies I\otimes^L Rf_*P with Rf_*(Lf^*I\otimes^L P). By adjunction, the vanishing composite in the preceding step implies that Lf^*I\otimes^L P\to P\to a(Q) is zero.

On U=f^{-1}(V) the map Lf^*I\to\mathcal O_X is an isomorphism, so the composite Lf^*I\otimes^L P\to P\to a(Q) restricts on U to \beta|_U, which is nonzero; this contradicts its vanishing. Hence a(Q) is supported on X\setminus U.
